hints.title: Path Maximum Tracking
hints.text: A node X is good if on the path from root to X, there are no nodes with a value greater than X.

hints.title: Pass Down Current Maximum
hints.text: During traversal, pass the maximum value seen so far along the root-to-current path.

hints.title: Increment Counter and Branch
hints.text: If node.val >= max_so_far, increment good node count. Recurse on children passing max(max_so_far, node.val).

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking all ancestors individually from each node takes O(N * H) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Carrying running maximum down the call stack takes O(1) space per frame and O(N) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate passes running maximum down the recursive traversal cleanly.
